description.text: It is also availble for the 1-to-2-year visiting program. Those who do not meet the requirement of HSK score can at first apply for the Chinese Language Program for one year before studying in the relevant colleges or departments.Teaching ObjectivesTo nurture qualified and skilled talents who are well-versed in Chinese language and culture, who will have a good grasp of knowledge in international trade, management, and finance as well as the experience in operating and handling real-life projects, especially those pertaining to Chinese economy, society, and who understand the Chinese culture values, so as to meet the demands of the fast changing world economy.International Faculty GroupMost lecturers of the core & distinctive courses are fluent English-speaking lecturers recruited worldwide. All lecturers have practical experience in teaching and years of experience working in the industry. In addition, renowned scholars and practitioners will be invited to give lessons or lectures.Internship and Career DevelopmentIn order to nurture students mastering the practical skills, our university have designed a variety of social and business activities for students. We also assists students in their career development through the Center of Professional DevelopmentImmersion WeekOne week of immersion week in every semester provides students with opportunities to be exposed to industry seminars, lectures given by professors and practitioners, business forums and competitions, field trips, case studies, and group business projects and presentations to further reinforce their business knowledge and practical skills.Degree AwardedQualified student will be granted Master Degree of EconomicsCareer CounselingStudents will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, visits to companies, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, and career consultation.Future CareerThe university will help get employ chances in good companies and organizations.

duration.text: The International Trade at Central China Normal University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3888 USD/per year ￥ 28000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diplomaGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.photocopy of awards certificate If applicable 7. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.

requirements.text: graduate student with a good command of English
